reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Disable wsl_v5 linter by @negz in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6593", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: Disabling the wsl_v5 linter changes only how Crossplane's source code is checked during development; operators don't need to do anything.

proposed.statement: The wsl_v5 linter was disabled in Crossplane's development tooling; this has no operational effect on running Crossplane installations.
